id: \bMr. Mime
en: \bMr. Mime
it: \bMr. Mime

id: \rChloe: Yes? What do you want?
en: \rChloe: Yes? What do you want?
it: \rChloe: Sì? Che cosa vuoi?

id: \rChloe: What should I do with my life?
en: \rChloe: What should I do with my life?
it: \rChloe: Che cosa dovrei fare della mia vita?

id: \bOak: I'm looking forward to seeing your results.
en: \bOak: I'm looking forward to seeing your results.
it: \bOak: Non vedo l'ora di vedere i tuoi risultati.

id: \rDo you think he's taking applications?
en: \rDo you think he's taking applications?
it: \rSecondo te sta accettando candidature?

id: \rEevee
en: \rEevee
it: \rEevee

id: \bCerise: How did the Project Mew mission go? While you were gone, a call from Opal came in. She'd like you to visit her gym in Ballonlea.
en: \bCerise: How did the Project Mew mission go? While you were gone, a call from Opal came in. She'd like you to visit her gym in Ballonlea.
it: \bCerise: Com'è andata la missione del Progetto Mew? Mentre eri via, ha chiamato Poppy. Vorrebbe che andassi a trovarla nella sua Palestra a Ballonlea.

id: \bGoh: Hopefully it's not for more quizzes. Ready to go?
en: \bGoh: Hopefully it's not for more quizzes. Ready to go?
it: \bGoh: Speriamo non sia per altri quiz. Pronto a partire?

id: \bCerise: \PN, it's terrible. Pokémon all over the world are turning back into Eggs. Nobody knows what is happening or what is going on.
en: \bCerise: \PN, it's terrible. Pokémon all over the world are turning back into Eggs. Nobody knows what is happening or what is going on.
it: \bCerise: \PN, è terribile. In tutto il mondo i Pokémon stanno tornando a essere Uova. Nessuno sa cosa stia succedendo.

id: \bCerise: The issue began in Sinnoh, so we'll have to start our search there. Professor Rowan may have some idea as to where to go.
en: \bCerise: The issue began in Sinnoh, so we'll have to start our search there. Professor Rowan may have some idea as to where to go.
it: \bCerise: Il problema è cominciato a Sinnoh, quindi dovremo iniziare le ricerche da lì. Il Professor Rowan potrebbe avere qualche idea su dove andare.

id: \bGoh: Let's not waste any time. Are you ready?
en: \bGoh: Let's not waste any time. Are you ready?
it: \bGoh: Non perdiamo tempo. Sei pronto?

id: \bCerise: Thank you both for your quick response. Thanks to you all the Pokémon are safe.
en: \bCerise: Thank you both for your quick response.  Thanks to you all the Pokémon are safe.
it: \bCerise: Grazie a entrambi per la vostra prontezza.  Grazie a voi tutti i Pokémon sono salvi.

id: \bBack to less pressing matters, Allister, a Stow-on- Side Gym Leader, would like to meet you. He says he has something to help you with your battles.
en: \bBack to less pressing matters, Allister, a Stow-on- Side Gym Leader, would like to meet you. He says he has something to help you with your battles.
it: \bTornando a faccende meno urgenti, Onion, Capopalestra di Stow-on-Side, vorrebbe conoscerti. Dice di avere qualcosa che può aiutarti nelle lotte.

id: \bGoh: I could use something more relaxing. Ready to go?
en: \bGoh: I could use something more relaxing. Ready to go?
it: \bGoh: Mi ci vorrebbe qualcosa di più rilassante. Pronto a partire?

id: \bCerise: Wasn't your friend waiting for you in Canalave City?
en: \bCerise: Wasn't your friend waiting for you in Canalave City?
it: \bCerise: Il tuo amico non ti stava aspettando a Canalipoli?

id: \bCerise: I heard you're going to be visiting your friend at Mossdeep City.
en: \bCerise: I heard you're going to be visiting your friend at Mossdeep City.
it: \bCerise: Ho sentito che andrai a trovare il tuo amico a Verdeazzupoli.

id: \bCerise: Good luck in your next match.
en: \bCerise: Good luck in your next match.
it: \bCerise: Buona fortuna per il tuo prossimo incontro.

id: \bCerise: I heard Goh was in Lilycove City right now.
en: \bCerise: I heard Goh was in Lilycove City right now.
it: \bCerise: Ho sentito che Goh si trova a Porto Alghepoli in questo momento.

id: \bCerise: An unknown Pokémon has been spotted in the Crown Tundra. I'd like the both of you to investigate it.
en: \bCerise: An unknown Pokémon has been spotted in the Crown Tundra. I'd like the both of you to investigate it.
it: \bCerise: È stato avvistato un Pokémon sconosciuto nella Landa Corona. Vorrei che voi due indagaste.

id: \bThe train station in Wyndon can take you there.
en: \bThe train station in Wyndon can take you there.
it: \bIl treno dalla stazione di Wyndon può portarti lì.

id: \bCerise: You need to visit Professor Oak. Give him my regards.
en: \bCerise: You need to visit Professor Oak. Give him my regards.
it: \bCerise: Devi andare a trovare il Professor Oak. Portagli i miei saluti.

id: \bCerise: Goh is looking for you in the park.
en: \bCerise: Goh is looking for you in the park.
it: \bCerise: Goh ti sta cercando nel parco.

id: \bCerise: The Masters Tournament has begun. I believe in you.
en: \bCerise: The Masters Tournament has begun. I believe in you.
it: \bCerise: Il Torneo dei Master è cominciato. Io credo in te.

id: \bCerise: I watched all of your battles. You did a great job.
en: \bCerise: I watched all of your battles. You did a great job.
it: \bCerise: Ho guardato tutte le tue lotte. Hai fatto un ottimo lavoro.

id: \bGoh is somewhere in the city waiting for you. He had something he wanted to talk to you about.
en: \bGoh is somewhere in the city waiting for you. He had something he wanted to talk to you about.
it: \bGoh ti sta aspettando da qualche parte in città. Voleva parlarti di una cosa.

id: \bCerise: So the two of you are leaving? As much as I'll miss you, I know this is what's best.
en: \bCerise: So the two of you are leaving? As much as I'll miss you, I know this is what's best.
it: \bCerise: Quindi ve ne andate? Per quanto mi mancherete, so che è la cosa migliore.

id: \bGoh: Thank you, Professor. I'll be sure to visit. My Pokémon will be in good hands with you.
en: \bGoh: Thank you, Professor. I'll be sure to visit. My Pokémon will be in good hands with you.
it: \bGoh: Grazie, Professoressa. Verrò sicuramente a trovarla. I miei Pokémon saranno in buone mani con lei.

id: \bCerise: Before you go, I have a gift for you. Use it well.
en: \bCerise: Before you go, I have a gift for you. Use it well.
it: \bCerise: Prima che andiate, ho un regalo per voi. Usatelo bene.

id: \bI have one last piece of advice for you. Be sure to check your phone often and refresh yourself on your notes. It helps to stay organized.
en: \bI have one last piece of advice for you. Be sure to check your phone often and refresh yourself on your notes. It helps to stay organized.
it: \bHo un ultimo consiglio per te. Controlla spesso il telefono e rileggi i tuoi appunti. Aiuta a restare organizzati.

id: \bCerise: I have one last piece of advice for you. Be sure to check your phone often and refresh yourself on your notes. It helps to stay organized.
en: \bCerise: I have one last piece of advice for you. Be sure to check your phone often and refresh yourself on your notes. It helps to stay organized.
it: \bCerise: Ho un ultimo consiglio per te. Controlla spesso il telefono e rileggi i tuoi appunti. Aiuta a restare organizzati.

id: \bTake care.
en: \bTake care.
it: \bAbbi cura di te.

id: \rDragonite
en: \rDragonite
it: \rDragonite

id: \bYamper!
en: \bYamper!
it: \bYamper!

id: \bCerise: Thank you for visiting my lab.
en: \bCerise: Thank you for visiting my lab.
it: \bCerise: Grazie per aver visitato il mio laboratorio.

id: \bCerise: There's a bed upstairs the two of you can use. We'll get started on our work tomorrow.
en: \bCerise: There's a bed upstairs the two of you can use. We'll get started on our work tomorrow.
it: \bCerise: Al piano di sopra c'è un letto che potete usare. Domani cominceremo a lavorare.

id: \bCerise: A mass outbreak of Ivysaur has appeared in the city. Go investigate it.
en: \bCerise: A mass outbreak of Ivysaur has appeared in the city. Go investigate it.
it: \bCerise: In città è apparso uno sciame di Ivysaur. Andate a indagare.

id: \bCerise: So the mass outbreak was caused by Team Rocket? I'm glad you were there to handle it.
en: \bCerise: So the mass outbreak was caused by Team Rocket? I'm glad you were there to handle it.
it: \bCerise: Quindi lo sciame era causato dal Team Rocket? Sono contenta che c'eravate voi a occuparvene.

id: \bNow that that's been handled, let me give you the project I intended on. Goh found an article about the phenomenon that causes Pokémon to grow giant.
en: \bNow that that's been handled, let me give you the project I intended on. Goh found an article about the phenomenon that causes Pokémon to grow giant.
it: \bOra che è tutto sistemato, lasciate che vi affidi il progetto che avevo in mente. Goh ha trovato un articolo sul fenomeno che fa diventare giganti i Pokémon.

id: \bThis only happens in the Galar region, so I'll need you to go there to discover what's happening.
en: \bThis only happens in the Galar region, so I'll need you to go there to discover what's happening.
it: \bSuccede solo nella regione di Galar, quindi dovrete andare lì a scoprire cosa sta succedendo.

id: \bYou can take a train there from Saffron City.
en: \bYou can take a train there from Saffron City.
it: \bPotete prendere un treno da Zafferanopoli.

id: \bCerise: You can take a train to Galar from Saffron City.
en: \bCerise: You can take a train to Galar from Saffron City.
it: \bCerise: Potete prendere un treno per Galar da Zafferanopoli.

id: \bCerise: So you found a giant Snorlax? Good work. I'll have to research this more on my own.
en: \bCerise: So you found a giant Snorlax? Good work.  I'll have to research this more on my own.
it: \bCerise: Quindi avete trovato uno Snorlax gigante? Ottimo lavoro.  Dovrò approfondire la cosa per conto mio.

id: \bI don't want to overload you with one project after the next. Why don't you take a break and visit the Battle Frontier in Hoenn?
en: \bI don't want to overload you with one project after the next. Why don't you take a break and visit the Battle Frontier in Hoenn?
it: \bNon voglio sommergervi di progetti uno dopo l'altro. Perché non vi prendete una pausa e visitate il Parco Lotta a Hoenn?

id: \bYou can get there from the ship at the harbor.
en: \bYou can get there from the ship at the harbor.
it: \bCi potete arrivare con la nave al porto.

id: \bCerise: I heard from Goh you won the Flute Cup. Good job!
en: \bCerise: I heard from Goh you won the Flute Cup.  Good job!
it: \bCerise: Goh mi ha detto che hai vinto la Coppa Flauto.  Complimenti!

id: \bYou just missed Goh, however. He heard about Dragonite sightings and left to go catch one.
en: \bYou just missed Goh, however. He heard about Dragonite sightings and left to go catch one.
it: \bPerò Goh se n'è appena andato. Ha sentito di alcuni avvistamenti di Dragonite ed è partito per catturarne uno.

id: \bHe should be at Dragonite Island now. You can meet up with him by taking the boat to the west of the one you were just on.
en: \bHe should be at Dragonite Island now. You can meet up with him by taking the boat to the west of the one you were just on.
it: \bOra dovrebbe essere sull'Isola Dragonite. Puoi raggiungerlo prendendo la barca a ovest di quella su cui eri poco fa.

id: \bCerise: There you are. I have some exciting news for you both. I acquired two tickets for the World Coronation Series.
en: \bCerise: There you are. I have some exciting news for you both. I acquired two tickets for the World Coronation Series.
it: \bCerise: Eccovi qui. Ho una notizia emozionante per entrambi. Ho ottenuto due biglietti per le World Coronation Series.

id: \bGoh: World Coronation Series? What's that?
en: \bGoh: World Coronation Series? What's that?
it: \bGoh: World Coronation Series? Che cosa sono?

id: \bCerise: It's similar to a league, but instead of taking place in one region and having a Champion, it takes place across the world and crowns the Monarch.
en: \bCerise: It's similar to a league, but instead of taking place in one region and having a Champion, it takes place across the world and crowns the Monarch.
it: \bCerise: Sono simili a una Lega, ma invece di svolgersi in una sola regione e incoronare un Campione, si svolgono in tutto il mondo e incoronano il Monarca.

id: \bThe finals is taking place soon. You should hurry to Wyndon before you miss it.
en: \bThe finals is taking place soon. You should hurry to Wyndon before you miss it.
it: \bLe finali si terranno presto. Dovreste sbrigarvi ad andare a Wyndon prima di perderle.

id: \bCerise: How was the battle? I hope you enjoyed it.
en: \bCerise: How was the battle? I hope you enjoyed it.
it: \bCerise: Com'è andata la lotta? Spero vi sia piaciuta.

id: \bThis time I need the two of you to head to the Colossus Ruins in the Desert Resort. The Pokémon inside might have a connection to the ones in Galar.
en: \bThis time I need the two of you to head to the Colossus Ruins in the Desert Resort. The Pokémon inside might have a connection to the ones in Galar.
it: \bStavolta ho bisogno che andiate alle Rovine del Colosso, nel Deserto della Quiete. I Pokémon al loro interno potrebbero avere un legame con quelli di Galar.

id: \bYou can find your way there by traveling to Route 4 in Unova.
en: \bYou can find your way there by traveling to Route 4 in Unova.
it: \bPer arrivarci, dovete andare al Percorso 4 di Unima.

id: \bGoh: This sounds like an opportunity to catch some Pokémon. I'm ready if you are. Do you want to go now?
en: \bGoh: This sounds like an opportunity to catch some Pokémon. I'm ready if you are. Do you want to go now?
it: \bGoh: Mi sembra un'occasione per catturare qualche Pokémon. Io sono pronto, se lo sei anche tu. Vuoi andare adesso?

id: \bCerise: Are you ready, \PN? The World Coronation Series's next season has officially started.
en: \bCerise: Are you ready, \PN? The World Coronation Series's next season has officially started.
it: \bCerise: Sei pronto, \PN? La nuova stagione delle World Coronation Series è ufficialmente iniziata.

id: \bLet's get you registed through your Rotom Phone.
en: \bLet's get you registed through your Rotom Phone.
it: \bTi iscriviamo tramite il tuo Smart Rotom.

id: Rotom Phone: ...Registed: Trainer \PN. Normal Class. Nearby opponent Visquez, located in the Vermilion City Gym, is ready for battle.
en: Rotom Phone: ...Registed: Trainer \PN. Normal Class. Nearby opponent Visquez, located in the Vermilion City Gym, is ready for battle.
it: Smart Rotom: ...Iscritto: Allenatore \PN. Classe Normale. L'avversario più vicino, Visquez, si trova nella Palestra di Aranciopoli ed è pronto a lottare.

id: \bGoh: Woah, you've already matched up with someone?
en: \bGoh: Woah, you've already matched up with someone?
it: \bGoh: Wow, hai già trovato un avversario?

id: \bCerise: There are already over 10,000 participants. It makes sense that everyone is eager for battle. \PN, go ahead and meet up with them.
en: \bCerise: There are already over 10,000 participants.  It makes sense that everyone is eager for battle. \PN, go ahead and meet up with them.
it: \bCerise: Ci sono già più di 10.000 partecipanti.  È normale che tutti non vedano l'ora di lottare. \PN, vai pure a incontrarlo.

id: \bCerise: \PN, go ahead and meet up with them at the Vermilion Gym.
en: \bCerise: \PN, go ahead and meet up with them at the Vermilion Gym.
it: \bCerise: \PN, vai pure a incontrarlo alla Palestra di Aranciopoli.

id: \bCerise: Good, you've both here. I need you to head to the Resort Area in Sinnoh.
en: \bCerise: Good, you've both here. I need you to head to the Resort Area in Sinnoh.
it: \bCerise: Bene, siete qui tutti e due. Ho bisogno che andiate all'Area Svago di Sinnoh.

id: \bThere's been rumors of a mysterious Pokémon said to be hiding in a local lake. See if you can find it.
en: \bThere's been rumors of a mysterious Pokémon said to be hiding in a local lake. See if you can find it.
it: \bGira voce che un misterioso Pokémon si nasconda in un lago della zona. Vedete se riuscite a trovarlo.

id: \bCerise: I'm happy the two of you were able to find the Magikarp before Team Rocket. It-
en: \bCerise: I'm happy the two of you were able to find the Magikarp before Team Rocket. It-
it: \bCerise: Sono felice che siate riusciti a trovare il Magikarp prima del Team Rocket. Ha-

id: Rotom Phone: Announcement. The World Coronation Series is hosting a Battle Festival Challenge in Shalour City in the Kalos region.
en: Rotom Phone: Announcement. The World Coronation Series is hosting a Battle Festival Challenge in Shalour City in the Kalos region.
it: Smart Rotom: Annuncio. Il World Coronation Series organizza una Sfida del Festival della Lotta a Yantaropoli, nella regione di Kalos.

id: \bGoh: It's in Kalos. That's a great chance to catch some Kalos Pokémon. Should we go now?
en: \bGoh: It's in Kalos. That's a great chance to catch some Kalos Pokémon. Should we go now?
it: \bGoh: È a Kalos. È un'ottima occasione per catturare qualche Pokémon di Kalos. Andiamo adesso?

id: \bCerise: So you've entered the Great Class? That's fantastic!
en: \bCerise: So you've entered the Great Class? That's fantastic!
it: \bCerise: Quindi sei entrato nella Classe Super? È fantastico!

id: \bCerise: Speaking of, I think the Galar Champion is having a match soon. You should head to Wyndon and watch.
en: \bCerise: Speaking of, I think the Galar Champion is having a match soon. You should head to Wyndon and watch.
it: \bCerise: A proposito, credo che il Campione di Galar abbia presto un incontro. Dovresti andare a Wyndon a guardarlo.

id: \bGoh: I'm ready to go. Are you good to go, \PN?
en: \bGoh: I'm ready to go. Are you good to go, \PN?
it: \bGoh: Io sono pronto a partire. Tu sei pronto, \PN?

id: \bCerise: How are your battles going? If you're looking to take a break, Goh is at the Pokémon Center right now taking place in a trade event.
en: \bCerise: How are your battles going? If you're looking to take a break, Goh is at the Pokémon Center right now taking place in a trade event.
it: \bCerise: Come vanno le tue lotte? Se vuoi prenderti una pausa, Goh è al Centro Pokémon in questo momento, a partecipare a un evento di scambi.

id: \bCerise: I think Goh was looking for you in the park out back.
en: \bCerise: I think Goh was looking for you in the park out back.
it: \bCerise: Credo che Goh ti stesse cercando nel parco qui dietro.

id: \bCerise: You have a match in Saffron City? Don't let me hold you up.
en: \bCerise: You have a match in Saffron City? Don't let me hold you up.
it: \bCerise: Hai un incontro a Zafferanopoli? Non ti trattengo oltre.

id: \bCerise: Thank you for joining us, \PN. A sandstorm has appeared in Mauville City. The people there have been pushed out as a result.
en: \bCerise: Thank you for joining us, \PN. A sandstorm has appeared in Mauville City. The people there have been pushed out as a result.
it: \bCerise: Grazie per essere venuto, \PN. Una tempesta di sabbia si è abbattuta su Ciclamipoli. Di conseguenza, gli abitanti sono stati costretti ad andarsene.

id: \bNot only that, but a hauntingly beautiful song from inside the sandstorm is seemingly hypnotizing the citizens.
en: \bNot only that, but a hauntingly beautiful song from inside the sandstorm is seemingly hypnotizing the citizens.
it: \bE non solo: un canto di una bellezza inquietante proveniente dalla tempesta sembra ipnotizzare i cittadini.

id: \bGoh: This sounds like something we can handle. \PN, I know you've been struggling with your last few matches. Ready to give this a shot?
en: \bGoh: This sounds like something we can handle.  \PN, I know you've been struggling with your last few matches. Ready to give this a shot?
it: \bGoh: Sembra qualcosa che possiamo gestire.  \PN, so che hai avuto difficoltà negli ultimi incontri. Te la senti di provarci?

id: \bCerise: Thank you both for dealing with that Flygon. I wonder what caused it do that to the city?
en: \bCerise: Thank you both for dealing with that Flygon.  I wonder what caused it do that to the city?
it: \bCerise: Grazie a entrambi per esservi occupati di quel Flygon.  Chissà cosa l'ha spinto a fare questo alla città?

id: \bRegardless, I recieved a call while you were both gone from Professor Kukui. He'd like for \PN to come to Alola to visit. Goh, you're welcomed as well.
en: \bRegardless, I recieved a call while you were both gone from Professor Kukui. He'd like for \PN to come to Alola to visit. Goh, you're welcomed as well.
it: \bIn ogni caso, mentre eravate via ho ricevuto una chiamata dal Professor Kukui. Vorrebbe che \PN andasse a trovarlo ad Alola. Anche tu sei il benvenuto, Goh.

id: \bGoh: Thank you for inviting me. \PN, I guess I'm ready to go. Are you?
en: \bGoh: Thank you for inviting me. \PN, I guess I'm ready to go. Are you?
it: \bGoh: Grazie per avermi invitato. \PN, direi che sono pronto a partire. E tu?

id: \bCerise: How are your battles going?
en: \bCerise: How are your battles going?
it: \bCerise: Come vanno le tue lotte?

id: \bCerise: Goh is waiting for you at Route 10. It's to the east of here.
en: \bCerise: Goh is waiting for you at Route 10. It's to the east of here.
it: \bCerise: Goh ti sta aspettando al Percorso 10. Si trova a est di qui.

id: \bCerise: I heard from Goh that Zapdos was a difficult challenge. At the very least, you did manage to stop it from causing another power outage.
en: \bCerise: I heard from Goh that Zapdos was a difficult challenge. At the very least, you did manage to stop it from causing another power outage.
it: \bCerise: Goh mi ha detto che Zapdos è stata una sfida difficile. Almeno siete riusciti a impedirgli di causare un altro blackout.

id: \bCerise: You should... \PN, what's that red glow coming from you?
en: \bCerise: You should... \PN, what's that red glow coming from you?
it: \bCerise: Dovresti... \PN, cos'è quel bagliore rosso che emani?

id: \bGoh: It's the Dynamax Band. But that can't be used outside of Galar.
en: \bGoh: It's the Dynamax Band. But that can't be used outside of Galar.
it: \bGoh: È il Polsino Dynamax. Ma non si può usare fuori da Galar.

id: \bCerise: That is concerning. You should head to Wedgehurst in Galar to meet with Professor Magnolia. She's the leading expert on Dynamax.
en: \bCerise: That is concerning. You should head to Wedgehurst in Galar to meet with Professor Magnolia. She's the leading expert on Dynamax.
it: \bCerise: È preoccupante. Dovresti andare a Wedgehurst, a Galar, e incontrare la Professoressa Magnolia. È la massima esperta di Dynamax.

id: \bYou can get there by taking the train in Saffron.
en: \bYou can get there by taking the train in Saffron.
it: \bCi puoi arrivare prendendo il treno a Zafferanopoli.

id: \bCerise: You can get to Wedgehurst by taking the train in Saffron.
en: \bCerise: You can get to Wedgehurst by taking the train in Saffron.
it: \bCerise: Puoi arrivare a Wedgehurst prendendo il treno a Zafferanopoli.

id: \bCerise: I'm glad the both of you were able to stop a crisis. Take a break and get back to your battles.
en: \bCerise: I'm glad the both of you were able to stop a crisis. Take a break and get back to your battles.
it: \bCerise: Sono contenta che siate riusciti a sventare una crisi. Prendetevi una pausa e tornate alle vostre lotte.

id: \bCerise: You're back. Goh got impatient and couldn't wait. He went to Cero Island. You can find it through the boat at the far end of the port.
en: \bCerise: You're back. Goh got impatient and couldn't wait. He went to Cero Island. You can find it through the boat at the far end of the port.
it: \bCerise: Sei tornato. Goh era impaziente e non ce l'ha fatta ad aspettare. È andato sull'Isola Cero. Puoi raggiungerla con la barca in fondo al porto.

id: \bCerise: I guess Mew wasn't there. It's a shame, but I found something else exciting.
en: \bCerise: I guess Mew wasn't there. It's a shame, but I found something else exciting.
it: \bCerise: Immagino che Mew non ci fosse. Peccato, ma ho trovato qualcos'altro di interessante.

id: \bApparently, there are rare fossils in the Wild Area. You two should go investigate.
en: \bApparently, there are rare fossils in the Wild Area.  You two should go investigate.
it: \bA quanto pare, nelle Terre Selvagge ci sono dei fossili rari.  Dovreste andare a indagare.

id: \bGoh: I'm going to catch them and fill up the Pokédex even more. \PN, ready to go?
en: \bGoh: I'm going to catch them and fill up the Pokédex even more. \PN, ready to go?
it: \bGoh: Li catturerò e riempirò ancora di più il Pokédex. \PN, pronto a partire?

id: \bCerise: There you two are. My daughter reminded me about Glimwood Tangle and the Ponyta and Rapidash that live there.
en: \bCerise: There you two are. My daughter reminded me about Glimwood Tangle and the Ponyta and Rapidash that live there.
it: \bCerise: Eccovi qui. Mia figlia mi ha ricordato il Bosco Lucente e i Ponyta e Rapidash che ci vivono.

id: \bI was wondering if the two of you could head there and see if you could find one.
en: \bI was wondering if the two of you could head there and see if you could find one.
it: \bMi chiedevo se poteste andare lì e vedere se riuscite a trovarne uno.

id: \bYou'll have to go west from Hammerlocke, then north east from Stow-on-Side.
en: \bYou'll have to go west from Hammerlocke, then north east from Stow-on-Side.
it: \bDovrete andare a ovest da Hammerlocke, poi a nord-est da Stow-on-Side.

id: \bGoh: Of course, Professor. \PN, are you ready to go?
en: \bGoh: Of course, Professor. \PN, are you ready to go?
it: \bGoh: Certo, Professoressa. \PN, sei pronto a partire?

id: \bCerise: The Castle of Chivalry can be found by taking the blimp in Lumiose City. Enjoy your training.
en: \bCerise: The Castle of Chivalry can be found by taking the blimp in Lumiose City. Enjoy your training.
it: \bCerise: Puoi raggiungere il Castello della Cavalleria prendendo il dirigibile a Luminopoli. Buon allenamento.

id: \bCerise: Goh is waiting for you at Professor Oak's lab.
en: \bCerise: Goh is waiting for you at Professor Oak's lab.
it: \bCerise: Goh ti sta aspettando al laboratorio del Professor Oak.

id: \bGoh: Professor. I've recieved my qualifier mission from Project Mew. I need to find an Alolan Ninetales at Mount Coronet.
en: \bGoh: Professor. I've recieved my qualifier mission from Project Mew. I need to find an Alolan Ninetales at Mount Coronet.
it: \bGoh: Professoressa. Ho ricevuto la mia missione di qualificazione dal Progetto Mew. Devo trovare un Ninetales di Alola sul Monte Corona.

id: \bCerise: Wonderful. \PN, why don't you go with him? Moral support is always welcomed.
en: \bCerise: Wonderful. \PN, why don't you go with him?  Moral support is always welcomed.
it: \bCerise: Magnifico. \PN, perché non vai con lui?  Un sostegno morale è sempre gradito.

id: \bGoh: I'd welcome it. Are you ready to go?
en: \bGoh: I'd welcome it. Are you ready to go?
it: \bGoh: Mi farebbe piacere. Sei pronto a partire?

id: \bCerise: I'm glad you two are back. People in Sinnoh have been struggling with nightmares. I suspect a Darkrai is involved.
en: \bCerise: I'm glad you two are back. People in Sinnoh have been struggling with nightmares. I suspect a Darkrai is involved.
it: \bCerise: Sono contenta che siate tornati. A Sinnoh la gente è tormentata dagli incubi. Sospetto che c'entri un Darkrai.

id: \bThe nightmares are happening around Floaroma Town. Please go check it out.
en: \bThe nightmares are happening around Floaroma Town. Please go check it out.
it: \bGli incubi si verificano nei dintorni di Floraria. Andate a controllare, per favore.

id: \bGoh: Nightmares... That sounds serious. Let's go.
en: \bGoh: Nightmares... That sounds serious. Let's go.
it: \bGoh: Incubi... Sembra una cosa seria. Andiamo.

id: \bCerise: Goh is waiting for you at the Desert Resort.
en: \bCerise: Goh is waiting for you at the Desert Resort.
it: \bCerise: Goh ti sta aspettando al Deserto della Quiete.

id: Dracovish
en: Dracovish
it: Dracovish

id: \rMom: \PN, what do you think of this place? I think it's going to turn out just great.
en: \rMom: \PN, what do you think of this place? I think it's going to turn out just great.
it: \rMamma: \PN, cosa ne pensi di questo posto? Secondo me verrà proprio benissimo.

id: \bGoh: I wonder why Lugia was here?
en: \bGoh: I wonder why Lugia was here?
it: \bGoh: Chissà perché Lugia era qui?

id: \rI heard Professor Cerise has a daughter. I wonder where she is.
en: \rI heard Professor Cerise has a daughter. I wonder where she is.
it: \rHo sentito che la Professoressa Cerise ha una figlia. Chissà dov'è.

id: \bGengar
en: \bGengar
it: \bGengar

id: \bGoh: I wonder what Opal wants.
en: \bGoh: I wonder what Opal wants.
it: \bGoh: Chissà cosa vuole Poppy.

id: \bGoh: Pokémon around the world are turning into Eggs. We need to fix this before it's too late.
en: \bGoh: Pokémon around the world are turning into Eggs. We need to fix this before it's too late.
it: \bGoh: In tutto il mondo i Pokémon si stanno trasformando in Uova. Dobbiamo rimediare prima che sia troppo tardi.

id: \bGoh: Thankfully we were able to stop Team Rocket.
en: \bGoh: Thankfully we were able to stop Team Rocket.
it: \bGoh: Per fortuna siamo riusciti a fermare il Team Rocket.

id: \bGoh: You're heading to Mossdeep? Have fun.
en: \bGoh: You're heading to Mossdeep? Have fun.
it: \bGoh: Vai a Verdeazzupoli? Divertiti.

id: \bGoh: I need your help with my next Project Mew mission.
en: \bGoh: I need your help with my next Project Mew mission.
it: \bGoh: Ho bisogno del tuo aiuto per la mia prossima missione del Progetto Mew.

id: \bThe objective is to find an Articuno. My best guess is at the Seafoam Islands. I heard we can get there from Cinnabar Island.
en: \bThe objective is to find an Articuno. My best guess is at the Seafoam Islands. I heard we can get there from Cinnabar Island.
it: \bL'obiettivo è trovare un Articuno. Secondo me si trova alle Isole Spumarine. Ho sentito che ci si arriva dall'Isola Cannella.

id: \bAre you ready to go?
en: \bAre you ready to go?
it: \bSei pronto a partire?

id: \bGoh: You have a new battle, don't you? I'll be rooting for you.
en: \bGoh: You have a new battle, don't you? I'll be rooting for you.
it: \bGoh: Hai un nuovo incontro, vero? Farò il tifo per te.

id: \bGoh: The Crown Tundra. I wonder what we'll find there.
en: \bGoh: The Crown Tundra. I wonder what we'll find there.
it: \bGoh: La Landa Corona. Chissà cosa troveremo lì.

id: \bGoh: Starting out on my own is terrifying. But I know I need to experience it.
en: \bGoh: Starting out on my own is terrifying. But I know I need to experience it.
it: \bGoh: Partire da solo mi terrorizza. Ma so che devo farlo.

id: \bSirfetch'd
en: \bSirfetch'd
it: \bSirfetch'd

id: \bHi. I'm Ren, and this is Francois.
en: \bHi. I'm Ren, and this is Francois.
it: \bCiao. Io sono Ren, e lui è Francois.

id: \bI heard this lab used to be haunted.
en: \bI heard this lab used to be haunted.
it: \bHo sentito che questo laboratorio una volta era infestato dai fantasmi.

id: \bCerise: Good morning. I have your first assignment for you.
en: \bCerise: Good morning. I have your first assignment for you.
it: \bCerise: Buongiorno. Ho il vostro primo incarico.

id: \bA mass outbreak of Ivysaur has appeared in the city. Head out and investigate it.
en: \bA mass outbreak of Ivysaur has appeared in the city. Head out and investigate it.
it: \bIn città è apparso uno sciame di Ivysaur. Andate a indagare.

id: \bBut before you go, I have something that should help the both of you.
en: \bBut before you go, I have something that should help the both of you.
it: \bMa prima che andiate, ho qualcosa che dovrebbe esservi utile.

id: \bIf you get lost, you can use it and it will tell you where to go next.
en: \bIf you get lost, you can use it and it will tell you where to go next.
it: \bSe ti perdi, puoi usarlo e ti dirà dove andare.

id: \bGoh: Thank you, Professor. \PN, let's get going.
en: \bGoh: Thank you, Professor. \PN, let's get going.
it: \bGoh: Grazie, Professoressa. \PN, andiamo.

id: \bIt's about time this place opened.
en: \bIt's about time this place opened.
it: \bEra ora che questo posto aprisse.

id: \bRiolu
en: \bRiolu
it: \bRiolu

id: \bLucario
en: \bLucario
it: \bLucario

id: Rotom Phone: Announcement. New scheduled match for the World Coronation Series. The match will take place at the Kalos League against Drasna.
en: Rotom Phone: Announcement. New scheduled match for the World Coronation Series. The match will take place at the Kalos League against Drasna.
it: Smart Rotom: Annuncio. Nuovo incontro in programma per il World Coronation Series. L'incontro si terrà alla Lega di Kalos contro Lila.

id: Gengar seems like it trusts you. Would you like to take it with you?
en: Gengar seems like it trusts you. Would you like to take it with you?
it: Sembra che Gengar si fidi di te. Vuoi portarlo con te?

id: \rHello. I'm Chrysa, one of Professor Cerise's assistants.
en: \rHello. I'm Chrysa, one of Professor Cerise's assistants.
it: \rCiao. Sono Chrysa, una delle assistenti della Professoressa Cerise.

id: \rI'm excited to have you working here with us.
en: \rI'm excited to have you working here with us.
it: \rSono felice che lavorerai qui con noi.

id: \rIt was great working with you.
en: \rIt was great working with you.
it: \rÈ stato bello lavorare con te.

id: \rJessie: We'll be taking your Pokémon now.
en: \rJessie: We'll be taking your Pokémon now.
it: \rJessie: Adesso ci prendiamo i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bMeowth: You don't stand a chance.
en: \bMeowth: You don't stand a chance.
it: \bMeowth: Non hai speranze.

id: \bJames: Don't even try and resist us.
en: \bJames: Don't even try and resist us.
it: \bJames: Non provare nemmeno a opporti.

id: \bWobbuffet: Wobbuffet!
en: \bWobbuffet: Wobbuffet!
it: \bWobbuffet: Wobbuffet!

id: \bFarfetch'd
en: \bFarfetch'd
it: \bFarfetch'd

id: \bCerise: So you and Goh found the rare Pokémon, Lugia. That's quite the achomplishment.
en: \bCerise: So you and Goh found the rare Pokémon, Lugia. That's quite the achomplishment.
it: \bCerise: Quindi tu e Goh avete trovato il raro Pokémon Lugia. È un bel traguardo.

id: \bI have an idea. Why don't the two of you stay here as my research assistants?
en: \bI have an idea. Why don't the two of you stay here as my research assistants?
it: \bHo un'idea. Perché non restate qui come miei assistenti di ricerca?

id: \bGoh: Really? That would be great!
en: \bGoh: Really? That would be great!
it: \bGoh: Davvero? Sarebbe fantastico!

id: \rMom: \PN, how exciting. I'll leave Mimey here to watch over you.
en: \rMom: \PN, how exciting. I'll leave Mimey here to watch over you.
it: \rMamma: \PN, che emozione. Lascio qui Mimey a tenerti d'occhio.

id: \rI never thought this place would actually open.
en: \rI never thought this place would actually open.
it: \rNon avrei mai pensato che questo posto avrebbe aperto davvero.

id: \bGoh: I've never seen a mass outbreak before.
en: \bGoh: I've never seen a mass outbreak before.
it: \bGoh: Non avevo mai visto uno sciame prima d'ora.

id: \bGoh: I've never been to Galar before.
en: \bGoh: I've never been to Galar before.
it: \bGoh: Non sono mai stato a Galar.

id: \bGoh: The World Coronation Series. That sounds right up your alley, \PN.
en: \bGoh: The World Coronation Series. That sounds right up your alley, \PN.
it: \bGoh: Le World Coronation Series. Sembrano fatte apposta per te, \PN.

id: \bGoh: I'm going to catch a ton of new Pokémon.
en: \bGoh: I'm going to catch a ton of new Pokémon.
it: \bGoh: Catturerò un sacco di nuovi Pokémon.

id: \bGoh: You'll do great in your first battle.
en: \bGoh: You'll do great in your first battle.
it: \bGoh: Andrai alla grande nel tuo primo incontro.

id: \bGoh: Let's find that mysterious Pokémon.
en: \bGoh: Let's find that mysterious Pokémon.
it: \bGoh: Troviamo quel Pokémon misterioso.

id: \bGoh: I'm happy we were able to find Magikarp.
en: \bGoh: I'm happy we were able to find Magikarp.
it: \bGoh: Sono felice che siamo riusciti a trovare Magikarp.

id: \bGoh: You did great in your matches.
en: \bGoh: You did great in your matches.
it: \bGoh: Sei stato bravissimo nei tuoi incontri.

id: \bGoh: I wonder what's going on in Mauville.
en: \bGoh: I wonder what's going on in Mauville.
it: \bGoh: Chissà cosa sta succedendo a Ciclamipoli.

id: \bGoh: That Flygon was intense.
en: \bGoh: That Flygon was intense.
it: \bGoh: Quel Flygon era tosto.

id: \bGoh: Alola was fun. Maybe we could go again sometime.
en: \bGoh: Alola was fun. Maybe we could go again sometime.
it: \bGoh: Alola è stata divertente. Magari potremmo tornarci prima o poi.

id: \bGoh: I wonder what's causing your Dynamax Band to glow?
en: \bGoh: I wonder what's causing your Dynamax Band to glow?
it: \bGoh: Chissà perché il tuo Polsino Dynamax brilla?

id: \bGoh: What a journey that was. I'm glad to be getting back to searching for Mew.
en: \bGoh: What a journey that was. I'm glad to be getting back to searching for Mew.
it: \bGoh: Che viaggio è stato. Sono contento di tornare a cercare Mew.

id: \bGoh: Mewtwo gave me a lot to think about.
en: \bGoh: Mewtwo gave me a lot to think about.
it: \bGoh: Mewtwo mi ha dato molto su cui riflettere.

id: \bGoh: I've been catching a lot of Pokémon.
en: \bGoh: I've been catching a lot of Pokémon.
it: \bGoh: Ho catturato un sacco di Pokémon.

id: \bGoh: The Castle of Chivalry sounds like a good way to train some of my Pokémon. I might go as well.
en: \bGoh: The Castle of Chivalry sounds like a good way to train some of my Pokémon. I might go as well.
it: \bGoh: Il Castello della Cavalleria sembra un buon posto per allenare alcuni dei miei Pokémon. Magari ci vado anch'io.

id: \bGoh: I'm worried about Project Mew. Will I be good enough?
en: \bGoh: I'm worried about Project Mew. Will I be good enough?
it: \bGoh: Sono preoccupato per il Progetto Mew. Sarò all'altezza?

id: \bGoh: Darkrai sounds dangerous. We should hurry.
en: \bGoh: Darkrai sounds dangerous. We should hurry.
it: \bGoh: Darkrai sembra pericoloso. Dobbiamo sbrigarci.

id: Magnemite
en: Magnemite
it: Magnemite

id: \bCerise: Thank you, everyone, for visiting the opening of the Cerise Laboratory.
en: \bCerise: Thank you, everyone, for visiting the opening of the Cerise Laboratory.
it: \bCerise: Grazie a tutti per essere venuti all'inaugurazione del Laboratorio Cerise.

id: \bCerise: With your support, I'm certain I'll learn all there is about the world and Pokémon that inhabit it. It....
en: \bCerise: With your support, I'm certain I'll learn all there is about the world and Pokémon that inhabit it.  It....
it: \bCerise: Con il vostro sostegno, sono certa che scoprirò tutto ciò che c'è da sapere sul mondo e sui Pokémon che lo abitano.  Ha....

id: \bOh. It seems a rare Pokémon has been spotted in the harbor.
en: \bOh. It seems a rare Pokémon has been spotted in the harbor.
it: \bOh. Pare che sia stato avvistato un Pokémon raro al porto.

id: \b\PN, that sounds right up your alley. Why don't you go ahead and check it out?
en: \b\PN, that sounds right up your alley. Why don't you go ahead and check it out?
it: \b\PN, sembra fatto apposta per te. Perché non vai a dare un'occhiata?

id: \bI used to walk by this place at night. It always creeped me out.
en: \bI used to walk by this place at night. It always creeped me out.
it: \bDi notte passavo davanti a questo posto. Mi metteva sempre i brividi.

id: Rotom Phone: Announcement. New opponent found for the World Coronation Series. Maike, located in Saffron City, is ready for battle.
en: Rotom Phone: Announcement. New opponent found for the World Coronation Series. Maike, located in Saffron City, is ready for battle.
it: Smart Rotom: Annuncio. Trovato un nuovo avversario per il World Coronation Series. Maike, a Zafferanopoli, è pronta per la lotta.

en: Yes
it: Sì
